dialogues.speaker: Sochikov
dialogues.text: Please be careful... *sigh* With so many passengers today, I wonder if I'll still make it after work...

dialogues.speaker: Sochikov
dialogues.text: Make it to the Korolevskiy to see the latest play... It wasn't easy getting my hands on two tickets...

dialogues.speaker: Sochikov
dialogues.text: I was hoping to ask Iliana to go with me, too. *sigh* If I get off work late, I doubt I'll make it in time for the opening.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you get off late when there are more passengers?

dialogues.speaker: Sochikov
dialogues.text: More passengers means more potential problems, and dealing with those problems may delay the trains slightly.

dialogues.speaker: Sochikov
dialogues.text: And if the trains are delayed, that means safety officers like us get off work a little later than usual.
